title: Ormanetto / Clementino, Spain nunciature to the Secretariat, 1576-77 (ASV Segr. Stato Spagna 10; DECODE R117-R118)

documents.shelfmark: ASV Segr. Stato Spagna 10, f. 365 (DECODE R118)

plaintext.source: The clear Italian note under the figures is the contemporary decifrato, without the dateline (scritta alli 15 di ottobre); taken on 21 Sept 2026 for a non-decipherment because its abbreviations were misread.

transcription.notes: Our r118_cipher.txt has digits only: dots are not recorded and the cross-stroke on 2/4/5 is written 4 or X (24 = 2+, 44 = 4+), so it cannot carry the key. A. Devadas's token list (dec118.py) was compared with the scan for lines 1-3 and 5.

system.summary: Homophonic substitution on digit signs (two per letter, dotted and undotted, zero rule), a stroke on 2/4/5 as word end, a small nomenclator, no doubled letters, final nulls: the Spain nunciature's 'cifra ordinaria'.
system.sibling_key: none (key reconstructed by A. Devadas from R116 and R118 together; Meister p. 265 prints only the rules)
system.notes: R117 (the other record) is a clear Spanish memorial with Roman-numeral ducat sums, not a cipher. Lasry's 1580 Como key (R72) structure does not fit: odd second digits occur.

prior_solution.where: The Italian note on the leaf is the contemporary decipherment (minus the dateline).

conditions.human_role: Project-level: obtained a DECODE login with privileges and passed its session cookie (from the browser developer tools) to the model, set up Claude Code with Fable 5.1 or Opus 5, and posed the problem with /goal; occasionally offered encouragement or chose which of the model-identified leads to pursue. No target-specific intervention recorded. On 1 Oct 2026 an outside solver (A. Devadas) emailed a key; the owner asked the model to verify it against the project's own transcription and to write it up.
tools: crib_align.py (beam-search crib aligner with shuffled-crib control)
dec_aj.py (decoder rebuilt from the emailed key description)

solution.what: Downloaded the three DECODE images of R117 and R118 with the session cookie.
Read R117: a clear Spanish memorial on the Pamplona vacancy; the figures are Roman-numeral ducat sums.
Transcribed the six lines of R118 figures from zoomed crops.
Compared with Lasry's 1580 Como key (R72): even-second-digit letter codes cannot produce this text.
Aligned the Italian note under the cipher as its plaintext: 43 distinct tokens for 60 letters.
Same aligner on three shuffles of the note: 47, 51, 48 tokens; the note is not a clear fit.
Searched DECODE metadata for a Spain nunciature key 1570-80: none.

Outside key: A. Devadas (with Claude) emailed his reconstruction of the Spain nunciature's cifra ordinaria, built from this project's published images and ciphertext files, with a report of the reading of R116 and R118.
Compared A. Devadas's tokens with the scan, lines 1-3 and 5: 'scrita ali 15 di otobre / il nuntio a comunicato col secretario Perez ...' reads off the page, the overlined 15 and 19 are there.
dec118.py decodes the six lines with the key and compares each with his plaintext: 12 lines consistent, 0 differ.
The leaf's note agrees with the decipherment word for word, minus the dateline; the 21 Sept crib failed because the note was read wrongly (trattato, buoni uffici, sabbato).
The same key reads R116 (ormanetto1573), an independent ciphertext, as Italian.

outcome.method: read after matching with key from external sources
outcome.method_basis: The Spain nunciature's cifra ordinaria, reconstructed by A. Devadas and emailed on 1 Oct 2026, reads all six lines of R118 (Italian, with dateline and six final nulls); lines 1-3 and 5 compared with the scan; the leaf's own note is the decifrato.
outcome.notes: R117 is not a cipher. The year of R118 (1576 Ormanetto, or 1577 Sega four days after reaching Madrid) and the writer 'Clementino' stay open.

credits.note: Spain nunciature cifra ordinaria (emailed 1 Oct 2026) reads R118
